name: mu-income-tax
description: Mauritius personal income tax for the income year 1 July 2026 to 30 June 2027. Covers residence, the 0, 10, 20 and 35 percent bands set by the Finance Act 2026, the end of the individual Fair Share Contribution, dependent deductions and reliefs, the Current Payment System, the 1 percent presumptive tax for small enterprises, the annual return due 15 October, penalties and foreign income. Use for questions on how much tax an employee, self-employed person or landlord pays in Mauritius, MRA individual returns, CPS statements, or when a Mauritius tax return is due.
